请使用支持 WebGL 的现代浏览器，并开启图形加速。

从一间教室，走向各自的远方。

  • 学校旧名按原图保留。点击学校可以查看位置来源。
  • 缩小看地区人数；放大看学校和姓名引线。国内／海外按钮可切换区域。

业务数据已内嵌在本文件中；如果构建时附加了原图，可在本机查看对照。主要功能可离线使用；学校周边的详细地图需联网。可导出完整业务数据供后续维护。

地图：MapLibre GL JS 5.6.2 · Made with Natural Earth。街道底图：OpenFreeMap / OpenMapTiles / © OpenStreetMap contributors。学校参考位置来源详见各学校卡片。坐标系：WGS84。

Natural Earth map data, retrieved 2026-11-08.
License: Public domain. https://www.naturalearthdata.com/about/terms-of-use/
Coordinate system: geographic longitude/latitude, WGS84 (EPSG:4326).
Official CRS description: https://www.naturalearthdata.com/features/

Province geometry source (10m):
https://raw.githubusercontent.com/nvkelso/natural-earth-vector/master/geojson/ne_10m_admin_1_states_provinces.geojson
Output china-provinces.json: 34 features. Mainland province-level units retained; Hong Kong districts, Taiwan counties/cities, and Macao units dissolved to region outlines. Source Paracel Islands geometries merged into Hainan. Geometry simplified at tolerance 0.008 degrees with topology preservation, rounded to 5 decimals. centroid is an interior representative label point, not a true area centroid. Name and shortName are Chinese display names. Natural Earth is a generalized cartographic reference, not authoritative cadastral/administrative surveying data.

World background source (110m):
https://raw.githubusercontent.com/nvkelso/natural-earth-vector/master/geojson/ne_110m_admin_0_countries.geojson
Output world.json: 176 features, Antarctica removed; invalid source geometries repaired with buffer(0); rounded to 5 decimals.

Suggested attribution: Made with Natural Earth.
These are general reference maps for an illustrative class destination visualization. School demo coordinates should be checked independently before real deployment.
